description: neroAacEnc 1.5.4.0 and neroAacTag 1.5.4.0: neroAacEnc -lc -cbr 128000 -if music-44k-stereo.wav; neroAacTag with -meta:title, -meta:artist and -meta:album set to a title of German letters, an artist in Cyrillic and an album in Japanese katakana, on the synthetic source music-44k-stereo.wav.

commands: neroAacTag with -meta:title, -meta:artist and -meta:album set to a title of German letters, an artist in Cyrillic and an album in Japanese katakana

input.name: music-44k-stereo.wav
input.generator: sources/make_sources.py of the sample kit (written from nothing, reproducible byte for byte)

selected_for: non-ASCII text in neroAacTag's box and in the iTunes metadata
note: The encoder stamps the time of the encode into the file; the file is committed as written, and checked by its content.
license: Nero's license limits how the software is used, not the files it writes.
